hints.title: Account Indexing
hints.text: Store balance entries with one-indexed account lookups.

hints.title: Bounds and Funds Verification
hints.text: Validate account bounds and ensure sufficient funds before mutating amounts.

hints.title: Atomic Validation
hints.text: Return false immediately when account indices are invalid or overdraft occurs.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) per transfer, deposit, and withdraw invocation
complexity.notes: Validates 1-indexed account identifiers and sufficient funds.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to validate account boundaries or balance before mutation leads to corrupted state.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct array indexing achieves instantaneous constant time operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check validation guardrails before performing mutations.
